## What it is

This is the section index for setting up the third-party services that the Digital Sales Rooms (DSR) plugin relies on. DSR itself does not provide realtime video streaming or realtime messaging; it integrates with two external services for these capabilities, and this page introduces the setup procedure for each, detailed on the following child pages.

## When to use

Consult this page after completing the DSR plugin and frontend installation, before DSR's realtime features (video calls and live updates) can work, since both depend on accounts and credentials configured with these external services.

## Essential identifiers

- Daily.co — the third-party service DSR uses for realtime video calls between attendees.
- Mercure — the third-party service DSR uses for its realtime messaging/service updates.
